scope: Broad overhead screen: all fixed partitions/trees with a bounded split grid, not fully tuned strongest methods or an application claim
persistent_fixed_ablation_definition: Fixed M32 persistent rows retain extra masked MMA work versus compact dynamic rows; fullcol_guard/persistent is not a pure state-transport-only change.
best_bank_control_definition: Fastest qualified non-v4 required family, including persistent/fullcol/v2/v3/native/E1/E4. Control grid retained in full; v4 is only split64 with N32/N64, a two-point pilot.

provenance.decode_step_definition: s1 is each actual suffix-prefill query predicting first generated token (selector compatibility only); s16/s64/s256 are same-forward ready-group snapshots anchored on question0 prediction step, with each request's own actual position retained
provenance.mask_definition: Budget applies to the full original document; protected partial-page document tail resides in private suffix and is omitted from common-source masks only. All original selected tokens remain in execution. Derived 64K/128K/full supports use identical frozen suffix-only scores; requests exceeding document length are explicitly clipped to full. The filename budget is a request, not the realized token count.

oracle_scope: Per-capture hindsight latency oracle among the measured grid; not a deployed plan selector.

full_union.note: Static-plan amortization scenarios, not measured request lifetimes; oracle search cost is reported separately and is not free.

limitations: Hierarchical split partial output is native BF16 and merged with FP32 log2-LSE weights; every tested configuration is separately qualified.
E4 uses exact binary-tree intersection/residual decomposition with all nodes batched, not the original QUILT code/planner.
Only shared-source KV is zero-copy; query gathering, normalized output restoration and hierarchical merge are included in run().
Plan preparation and actual prepare+one-run wall time are measured; search is reported separately, not silently amortized away.
Same-capture hot/cold controls do not establish common-ready overlap, generation quality, full-model speedup or energy improvement.
Persistent fixed-M32 versus compact FullCol changes masked MMA work; do not attribute the whole difference solely to state transport.
Bankpilot retains the full control grid but tests v4 at only split64/N32 and split64/N64; it is not a full v4 tuning or an application result.
